body:
Glad at heart, go where rites are done — and "where" is wherever your heart gladdens into fitness for sinking in the Lord. That is the whole mark: meditation melting into its object causes it; gladness causes that; so no elsewhere. Peaks and holy grounds in the books mean just this: powers, entered by the Lord, taking bodies there — noble lands for the righteous, barbarian lands for the rest — and hilltops, lonely, unscatter the mind. Before the rite-house, outside, dress hands then body in the general placing. Then the Mālinī mantras — power-worded, owner-worded: power first, then its owner; for freedom, foot to crown; for pleasure, reversed. Mālinī the goddess is power's chief shape — seed meeting womb, milking every wish. Her name tells it: garlanded with Rudra-powers, flowered into fruits, bee humming down saṃsāra's frost, holding wins and freedom, giving and withholding — all from ra and la remembered one. So even a botched mantra, set thus, comes whole; even anointed Garuḍa-Vaiṣṇava types, reaching stainlessness, give freedom. Then the argha vessel, the self poured in; the god-families; five states watched plus the unsurpassed sixth; sixfold placing; the causes Brahmā to Power each indwelt, the thirty-six past the world set in Bhairava's non-difference till full — becoming Bhairavī, past objection. ("Wavering mounted — what more with makings and placings?" The waveless IS Bhairava's body: creation-and-ending crores shown in himself.)

The passage moves in three steps. (1) Place = fitness, not geography (gladness + immersion-fit; peaks = powers taking bodies; solitude = one-pointedness). (2) Mālinī mantra: power-worded/owner-worded placing (freedom: foot-to-crown; enjoyment: reversed); Mālinī = chief power-form (seed-womb collision, all-wish-milking); etymology (Rudra-garlands, frost-bee, giving-withholding from ra-la oneness); repair doctrine (fallen rite completed; Garuḍa-Vaiṣṇava anointed reach stainless liberation). (3) After body-placing: argha vessel (self-offering); deity-family worship; five states + unsurpassed sixth; sixfold placing; causes Brahmā-to-Power; 36-host in Bhairava-nondifference → Bhairavī-becoming; wavering-objection dissolved (ataraṅga Bhairava-body = self-shown creation-dissolution-variety).
terms: yāgasthāna (rite-place = fitness), Mālinī (chief power-form, seed-womb), nyāsa (placing), argha (offering vessel), Bhairavī-becoming, ataraṅga (waveless).
function: Establishes rite-place as fitness (not geography), Mālinī mantra as repairing fallen rites and anointing outsiders, and the argha-to-Bhairavī arc.
local_context: A12 (snāna) precedes; A13 teaches yāga/dīkṣā; A14 (putraka) follows.
boundary: Mantra syllables assumed potent (traditional). Yantra details (trident-lotus stations) assume initiated readers (external). L1 CONDENSED for P3/P4.

body:
Middle: the Lord. Above him Īśāna's face; below, the underworld face; east and round, Tatpuruṣa, Aghora, Sadya, Vāma, and four between. Awareness's greatness alone shines directions into images — direction is no extra principle. As your shadow, meaning to pass it, keeps ahead of you — so reaching the Lord's middle; presiding over all just is being central. The sun divides directions the same way — he is the Lord's own knowing-power... frontness belongs to whatever place you face, self-ruled. Self-sun-Lord made one: that inquiry is "directions," say my teachers. Seated north, quit the I in the eightfold body-city and burn bodyness — near, yet as if another's, bodiless. Then, mounted on waveless fixed ground, by sheer gaze: the first throb-beat — that is the image. On it, set the worshipped god-wheel as taught — powers foremost (they seat the nine Lords; worship belongs to power, say the teachers). Watch five states plus the unsurpassed sixth as your own state: sixfold placing. Indwell the causes one by one — Brahmā to Power — and the thirty-six, past the world set in Bhairava's non-difference to fullness: becoming Bhairavī, no gap. (The wavering-objection, dissolved above.) Then melt breath, body, mind into goddess-and-Lord, and worship outside and in with flowers, smoke, libations as you can. In body, breath, mind set the trident-lotus: root in base-power, bulb-pith in the bulb, staff to art's end at the pipe's lip, Māyā for knot, fourfold bright-knowing lotus, Sadāśiva himself there — the Great Dead, dead by melting, by knowing, by the known-body's decay, by sound-grasp. Risen from the navel through three crown-holes, the triple inner music — power, pervader, harmony — to the twelve-end, three pure lotuses above, past mind: in that universe-made difference made a seat, presiding, pervading, picture the god you love. Pouring the universe's things into the selfsame full self — that is worship. Growing into it — meditation. The swing of holding it inside — muttering. Making the universe yourself by that awakened blaze — fire-giving. Make the retinue sparks off that heap and worship likewise. (Twelve-end foremost remembered from the root... goddess-wheel ahead, sky-faring, inner rite enough.)

The passage moves in five steps. (1) Five faces + direction doctrine: awareness-greatness shines directions into images; direction is no separate principle; shadow-transcending analogy; sun divides likewise; self-sun-Lord oneness = direction-inquiry. (2) Image = first throb-digit: waveless-fixed-abode-mounted, by gaze-nature; on it set worshipped god-wheel; powers foremost (they seat the nine Lords); worship belongs to power. (3) Five states + unsurpassed sixth = sixfold placing; causes Brahmā-to-Power indwelt; 36 past world in Bhairava-nondifference → Bhairavī-becoming; wavering-objection dissolved. (4) Mutual-melting into goddess-become breath-body-mind → outer-inner worship with flowers/smoke/libations. (5) Trident-lotus placing (root/bulb/staff/knot/lotus/Sadāśiva = Great Dead) + four inner definitions (worship/meditation/muttering/fire-offering) + retinue.
terms: digbhedam (direction-difference), mūrti (image), spandakalā (first throb-digit), nyāsa (placing), śūlābjanyāsa (trident-lotus placing), bhairavībhāva (Bhairavī-becoming).
see_also: A12 (snāna), A13 P1, P3, spans TS13.20–13.34.
function: Grounds image/directions in consciousness-greatness; defines the inner rite (worship/meditation/muttering/fire-offering).
local_context: P1 established place + nyāsa + argha; P2 takes up image/directions/inner rite.
boundary: Yantra details (trident-lotus stations) assume initiated readers (external). L1 CONDENSED for P3/P4 (full close pass queued).

body:
Inner rite alone truly finishes — yet do the outer to wear down limits; for the unimmersed the outer is chief (practice → immersion); even beast-bondage needs the inner (its resolve purifies). For initiation: adhivāsa prelims (ground-taking, Gaṇeśa, jar-pitcher worship, altar worship, fire-offering); daily/occasional = altar-fire only. Adhivāsa = pupil's fitness-making (teeth-whitening), god's readiness-grasping, teacher's grasping, implements' Lord-glow fitness. Full house: Mālinī recalled, glow-mass, flower-throw; charmed grains scattered NE-joined = ground-taking. Seat of knowing given, Gaṇapati honored, bliss-jar worshipped, retinue after the worshippable, chief mantra hundred-and-eighted into the jar; second pitcher with weapon-mantra; guardians; old pupil gets weapon-pitcher; teacher takes jar. Pupil streaming house-round with Śakra's charge; NE placing; straw and pitcher; double worship; middle Lord; fire seen as Lord-power, lit, one with heart-fire, mantras fed ghee and sesame; sprinkling refines; ladles' non-difference-view refines.

The passage moves in three steps. (1) Inner vs. outer: inner rite alone finishes; outer for limits; unimmersed → outer chief; beast-bondage needs inner. (2) Adhivāsa prelims: ground-taking, Gaṇeśa, jar-pitcher worship, altar worship, fire-offering; daily/occasional altar-fire only. (3) Full rite-house: Mālinī recalled, glow-mass, flower-throw; charmed grains NE-joined; knowledge-seat, Gaṇapati, bliss-jar, retinue, chief mantra 108-muttered jar, second pitcher astra, guardians, old pupil astra-pitcher, teacher jar; Śakra formula streaming, NE placing, straw/pitcher, double worship, middle Lord, fire as Lord-power with heart-fire, ghee/sesame feeding, sprinkling, ladles' nondifference-view.
terms: adhivāsa (lodging/prelim), Gaṇapati, bliss-jar (ānandadravya), astra (weapon-mantra), Śakra formula.
see_also: A12 (snāna), A13 P2, P4, spans TS13.35–13.61.
function: Builds the rite-house container (adhivāsa prelims) in which descent can be handled.

body:
Full-offering cake shared five ways; tooth-stick omens; weapon-mantra fire. The pupil, distraction-swept, blindfold, kneeling, flower-struck — then the cloth ripped: grace-touched senses see where mantra stands and grow into it (the present mantra plain to graced senses; trembling beings). Right hand, god-wheel worshipped, burns bonds at crown, heart, navel; left, soma-flooded, drowns in purity; bow. Feed outer spirits; sip; eat together as one self, awake. Bad dreams: untold (they breed doubt-fear); weapon-mantra only. Teacher breath-walks the pupil through six cause-points with eight sacraments each, rests his breath, descends — forty-eight plus Rudra's portion: samayin made. Mantra given with flowers; then the vows — devotion to teacher, book, god; no facing their foes; honor teacher-kin; sex vowed to worship only; no scorning; guarded names; no teacher's bed; no play nearby; no heights elsewhere; teacher honored at rites; no Śākinī-talk at feasts; holy days kept; no Vaiṣṇava company; no birth-eyes on fellows; feasting come teachers; dropped low-path teachers without contempt; no liṅgin mingling; doubts dropped; no birth-ranks in the wheel; body over shrines; heart-mantra always. Hearing, bowing, yes-saying, giving to wealth's end, feeding poor and old hands, rite-wheel fed for rites to come: samayin made. Mantra, daily, hearing, study — qualified; feast-days through the teacher.

The passage moves in five steps. (1) Full-offering cake shared five ways; tooth-stick omens; weapon-mantra fire. (2) Blind entry: distraction-cleared, bound-eyed, flower-struck; cloth ripped; grace-touched senses see present mantra-place and grow into it. (3) Grace-hand: right hand (god-wheel) burns bonds at crown/heart/navel; left (soma) floods purity; bow; outer spirit-bali; sipping; shared food = one self, awake. (4) Bad dreams untold (weapon-mantra remedy). (5) Teacher breath-enters pupil (six cause-points × 8 sacraments = 48 + Rudra-portion = samayin); mantra with flowers; samayas taught (devotion catalog); hearing/bowing/consenting/gifting/feeding/rite-wheel = samayin; mantra/daily/hearing/study qualified; feast-days through teacher.
function: Completes the initiation: blind entry, grace-hand, 48 sacraments, samaya-vows.
local_context: P3 built the rite-house; P4 brings the pupil in.
